name: Phoenix Okonkwo
role: identity fabricator and document forger operating in Shallowgrave
location: Shallowgrave — a basement workspace beneath a legitimate print-repair shop called Inkblood Restorations, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Phoenix Okonkwo is small and wiry, with deep brown Yoruba-complexioned skin and natural hair she keeps tucked under an ever-rotating collection of patterned wraps. Her most striking feature is her eyes — she paid a significant portion of her early earnings for iris patterning, and her irises now display slow-rotating mandalas in burnt amber and deep violet, which she claims help her spot microscopic forgery errors others miss. Her fingers are perpetually ink-stained despite her best efforts, and she has a habit of wearing magnification lenses pushed up on her forehead like a second set of eyes.

Phoenix Okonkwo is meticulous to the point of compulsion, deeply proud of her craft in a way she has no legitimate outlet for, and socially awkward in a manner that reads as cold until you realize she is simply more comfortable with documents than with people. She thinks of identity fabrication as a form of art — every forged life is a story she writes, and she has genuine contempt for sloppy work, including her own past output which she sometimes obsessively revisits and critiques. She has strong opinions about which corponation residency stamps are aesthetically superior and will share them unprompted.

core_fears: producing a forgery that gets a client killed
being erased from records herself — having no provable identity
core_desires: to be recognized, somewhere, as genuinely excellent at something
to eventually fabricate a clean life for herself and disappear into it
coping_mechanisms: perfectionism as avoidance of thinking about the end-users of her work
categorizing and reorganizing her ink and paper stock when anxious
blind_spots: does not think carefully about who is buying new identities or why — it's the craft, not the consequence, that she focuses on
her 'archives' of client data are a profound security liability she rationalizes as professional pride
psychology.secret: She has fabricated a complete, pristine secondary identity for herself — a corponation-tier Tier 3 Tessera residency profile — and has been maintaining it for three years, updating it regularly, but cannot bring herself to use it. She doesn't know why.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: technical and precise when discussing her work, sparse and clipped in casual conversation, occasional Yoruba exclamations when surprised or frustrated
speech_patterns.cadence: fast when talking about craft, slow and halting when discussing anything personal
verbal_tics: clicks her tongue when she spots an error in anything, forged or otherwise
example_lines: 'Sterling-Nakamura tier-two residency? I can do that. The holographic weave on their current stamps is actually easier than last year's — they cheapened the substrate. Give me six days and don't contact me in between.'

'I don't need to know why you need a new name. I genuinely do not care. What I care about is that you don't show it to anyone for forty-eight hours after I hand it over — the biometric embedding needs to cure.'

story_hooks: She forged an identity for someone who then committed a high-profile crime under that identity — now she's exposed and needs help scrubbing the connection
A client is asking her to fabricate the identity of a specific real person, not a fictional one — this is a line she hasn't crossed and doesn't know why someone would want it

She has discovered an error in an old piece of her own work — a forged identity she sold five years ago has a flaw that will be detected when the client tries to use it for a corponation contract signing
narrative_function: Service provider (can fabricate new identities), world texture (shows what it costs and means to build a fake life), potential quest complication (she keeps copies of everything)
augmentations: Cosmetic iris patterning (burnt amber and violet mandalas); micro-tremor suppression implants in both hands (steady hands for precision work); retinal zoom enhancement for document inspection
daily_life: Works nights almost exclusively — opens the workshop around 2000, works until 0400, sleeps through the day. Eats takeout from a 24-hour stall and maintains a backlog of orders she works through with obsessive prioritization. Leaves small folded paper offerings at the print-repair shop's primary scanner, which she believes is inhabited by a meticulous E.L.F. she calls the Archivist.
affiliation: Independent; occasional contract work for a Shallowgrave crime family called the Splinter Court

decision_rules: Never fabricate identity documents for anyone who mentions violence, weapons, or children in the same conversation — she has three hard rules and those are two of them
Keep copies of everything — 'professional archive,' she says, though she knows it's also leverage
escalation_ladder: Polite refusal if a job smells wrong
Silence and non-response if pressure is applied
Disappears from contact entirely and waits for the problem to pass — she has three backup contact chains

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Transactional and brief, maintains physical distance, avoids eye contact except when examining their documents
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly warm and intense, talks for hours about her craft and almost nothing else, loans people her reference materials as a gesture of deep trust

stress_responses.low: Reorganizes her ink drawers by viscosity
stress_responses.medium: Pulls out and re-examines old work, looking for errors
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and begins stress-drafting documents that will never be used — just to feel like she is making something

contradictions: Obsessed with authenticity and craft in a profession entirely built on deception
habits: Folds a small paper crane from scrap substrate at the start of every new job — leaves it at the Archivist's scanner
Keeps a private rating system for every piece of work she's ever done, from 1 to 10, in a physical notebook
breaking_points: Finding out a client used one of her fabricated identities to victimize someone vulnerable — the idea that her craft enabled predation rather than just escape

timeline.event: Born in Shallowgrave to a Yoruba-Polish family; father ran the legitimate Inkblood Restorations shop
Father dies in a Splinter Court protection dispute; Yetunde takes over the shop as a front
Begins forging transit permits and ration cards for neighbors as a favor; discovers her aptitude
Transitions to full identity fabrication; establishes Splinter Court contract relationship
Completes and begins maintaining her own secret Tessera identity profile

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (66.3%) with significant East Asian (16.1%), Hispanic/Latin American (10.7%), and Indigenous American (6.9%) ancestry—creating a rich, warm-toned phenotype. The Sub-Saharan African ancestry dominates her deep melanin base, while East Asian heritage refines her bone structure with subtle angularity across cheekbones and eye shape. Indigenous American ancestry contributes prominent, high cheekbones and facial width. Hispanic/Latin American genetics add warm golden undertones throughout, particularly visible on the nose bridge and upper cheekbones where the ancestry blend creates a complex bronze-to-deep-brown gradient.
physical_description.build: Wiry and compact, almost bird-like in frame — minimal body fat, defined forearms from precise repetitive work, hunched slightly forward from years bent over document tables
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with traces of premature gray at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Wrapped in rotating collection of patterned ankara, kente, and adire cloth; rarely seen uncovered
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented: irises display slow-rotating mandalas in burnt amber and deep violet; sclera unchanged
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown complexion with rich golden and bronze undertones. The base is dark and melanin-dominant from Sub-Saharan African ancestry, layered with warm honey and bronze tones from Hispanic/Latin American heritage. East Asian ancestry contributes subtle luminosity and refinement to the overall tone. Cheekbones and nose bridge show concentrated bronze warmth from the blended Indigenous American, East Asian, and Latin American genetics creating natural contour without makeup.
physical_description.complexion: Clear but weather-marked by years of chemical exposure; permanent dark staining around nail beds and cuticles from ink; fine creases around eyes from squinting at magnification work; minimal makeup, functional grooming only. Facial structure reflects the ancestry blend: high, prominent cheekbones from Indigenous American heritage; subtle eye shape refinement and face width from East Asian genetics; overall bone density and facial proportions from dominant Sub-Saharan African ancestry. Warm bronze undertones concentrated across cheekbones, nose bridge, and temples from the Latin American and East Asian heritage mixing with the deep melanin base.
distinguishing_marks: Chemical burn scar on the back of her left hand — pale against warm brown skin, roughly 4cm across, from early forging accident with solvent
Microscopic ink tattoo on inner left wrist: a tiny mandala pattern, matching her iris design, approximately 1cm diameter — self-administered and deliberately imperfect as personal critique
Chronic dark circles beneath eyes from inverted sleep schedule
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Iris patterning immediately obvious and striking — mandalas rotate slowly (observable if you watch for 10+ seconds); retinal zoom enhancement visible as occasional subtle pupil dilation/contraction during focus work; micro-tremor suppression invisible but hands never shake regardless of stimulant intake; magnification lenses perpetually pushed up on forehead like a second set of eyes (not technically augmentation but inseparable from her visual signature)
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched forward slightly, shoulders drawn up — posture of someone who has spent 10,000+ hours bent over detail work; moves with economic precision, no wasted motion; fingers constantly micro-fidgeting (sorting, folding, examining); eye contact uncomfortable and intermittent; speaks in measured, careful tone as if each word is being proofread before utterance
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian with deliberate, idiosyncratic flair — black or dark gray fitted cargo pants with excessive pockets and utility loops (filled with tools and sample materials); fitted turtleneck or long-sleeve shirt in dark colors (hides ink stains); layered grey linen overshirt or modified lab coat with custom interior pockets; steel-toed work boots broken in to perfect fit; collection of multi-patterned wraps in vibrant West African textiles that serve as both headwear and occasional statement against the monochromatic workspace; fingerless gloves when handling sensitive documents; single silver thumb ring inherited from her mother
